g5ela-23-1-listen-words: Two roots this week are about speaking. Voc, or voke, means voice or call. Dict means say. Then a year of spelling patterns, all in one sort. In the game, read each line and choose the word that fits the blank.
g5ela-23-2-listen-words: Today, decide whether each word carries voc and voke, calling out, or dict, saying and declaring. Then sort words by the rule that explains their spelling. Then three new lines to finish in the game.
g5ela-23-3-listen-words: Put the speaking roots to work today. Then learn how transition words, like but, because and instead, show how ideas connect. Then check your own draft, one spelling pattern at a time.
g5ela-23-4-listen-words: Last day with the speaking roots. Match words to the roots you have collected all year. Then explain a spelling pattern the way you would teach it to a friend, and finish the last lines of the game.
